description: This file is a Python script for generating JSON C++ classes, stub code, and API documentation from JSON definition files and C++ header files. It contains license info, constants, class definitions for enums, and a Parse function that processes command-line arguments to configure code generation options.

classes.name: RpcFormat
classes.description: Enum class representing JSON-RPC data format options: compliant, uncompliant-extended, uncompliant-collapsed.

classes.name: CaseConvention
classes.description: Enum class representing case conventions: standard, legacy, keep, custom.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Function to parse command-line arguments and set configuration globals for code generation.
